verdict.rationale: Grafana's docs say it queries, visualizes, and explores metrics, logs, and traces in one place, and its OpenTelemetry tooling collects all three signals plus profiles. Pivoting is documented: metrics-to-logs keeps label filters, Prometheus exemplars jump from metrics to Tempo traces, and Tempo links traces back to logs and metrics. A community user also confirms Grafana Cloud delivers metrics, logs, and tracing together. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the cross-signal pivot workflow, detailed evidence of trace-to-logs correlation mechanics.
